name: 逸  俠  之  世  界
english_description: Daniel's World, the same ES II-family, Taiwan-produced game as this collection's yxsj — including its unusual modern-campus starting map (classrooms, courtyard garden, lab building, kitchen, bike rack) and the Taiwanese Pili Puppetry (霹靂布袋戲) glove-puppet scenes woven into the jianghu backdrop — but a distinct build from a different point in the codebase's history: same title, same contact email, and the same file structure, yet not a byte-identical repackaging (its combatd.lpc, for instance, differs from yxsj's by roughly 80 lines) — worth keeping as a separate entry rather than treating as a duplicate.
